plugin.note: The task page's first equipment tab is Ranged multicombat: use the south-west cannonable multicombat area with Venator bow or chinchompas, Protect from Melee, and prayer restoration. Magic multicombat and melee single-combat setups are wiki-listed alternatives.

requirements: 54 Slayer and completion of Shadows of Custodia are required to be assigned Custodian stalkers.
67 Slayer is required to kill Mature custodian stalkers.
76 Slayer is required to kill Elder custodian stalkers; only elders can spawn Ancient Custodian superiors.
Bigger and Badder enables Ancient Custodian superior spawns.
mechanics: Custodian stalkers are aggressive and primarily attack with melee.
At 20% hitpoints, custodian stalkers stomp and douse the player in spores; the special can cause a bleed effect for 9 damage over 15 ticks.
Protect from Melee prevents most damage; Protect from Magic can block the special, but switching prayers while fighting multiple stalkers may be unwise.
High magic defence such as dragonhide armour reduces the chance of taking damage from the special attack.
The Stalker Den has multicombat cannonable zones in the south-west and single-combat caverns in the south-east and north.
A safespot is documented for Elder custodian stalkers in the western single-combat area.
Custodian stalkers have a 30% fire elemental weakness.

methods.label: Ranged multicombat
methods.summary: Use the Stalker Den's south-west multicombat cannonable area with Ranged gear, a Dwarf multicannon, and ricochet or area damage.
recommendedFor: Players using the task page's first equipment tab
requiredOrKeyItems: Venator bow, black chinchompas, red chinchompas, or chinchompas
Bracelet of slaughter to extend the task
Pendant of ates or other travel option
steps: Use the south-west multicombat section where cannons can be placed.
Set up the Dwarf multicannon; the wiki notes it is ideal for luring even though the stalkers are already aggressive.
Use Venator bow bounces or chinchompas to hit grouped stalkers.
Keep Protect from Melee active and restore prayer as needed.
Use bracelets of slaughter if extending the task is desired.
risks: Changing prayers for the bleed special while fighting several stalkers can be worse than staying on Protect from Melee.
Bring food because the special can still cause bleed damage.
inventory: Crystal halberd or other special attack weapon
notes: This method preserves the wiki's Ranged (Multicombat) equipment tab.

methods.label: Magic multicombat
methods.summary: Use the same multicombat cannon area with Magic gear and Ancient Magicks-style equipment when preferring magic.
recommendedFor: Players with strong magic gear or saturated heart
requiredOrKeyItems: Kodai wand, Nightmare staff, Dragon hunter wand, Ancient sceptre, Blue moon spear, Master wand, or Ancient staff
Saturated heart for magic accuracy or higher tier burst/barrage access
steps: Use the south-west multicombat section and place a Dwarf multicannon if available.
Cast multi-target Ancient Magicks or the best available magic option from the equipment tab.
Keep Protect from Melee active and restore prayer as needed.
Use high magic accuracy gear and consider saturated heart for better accuracy or spell access.
risks: Custodian stalkers have only a 30% fire weakness and non-trivial magic defence, so this is an alternative rather than the default plugin recommendation.
inventory: Crystal halberd or other special attack weapon
notes: This method preserves the wiki's Magic (Multicombat) equipment tab.

methods.label: Melee single-combat
methods.summary: Fight in the single-combat caverns with slash-focused melee gear, Piety, and Protect from Melee.
recommendedFor: Single-combat caverns in the south-east and north
Players using the Melee (Single combat) tab
requiredOrKeyItems: Blade of saeldor, Ghrazi rapier set to slash, Noxious halberd, Abyssal tentacle, Abyssal whip, Dual macuahuitl, Dragon scimitar, Arkan blade, or Belle's folly
Super combat potions or attack/strength potions
steps: Use the south-eastern or northern single-combat caverns when you do not want multicombat pressure.
Use a slash weapon where possible because custodian stalkers have negative slash defence.
Keep Protect from Melee and Piety active.
Carry food for bleed special chip damage.
risks: No cannon support in single-combat caverns.
The wiki notes that on a Slayer task, Slayer helmet plus slash weapon is superior to relying on Dual macuahuitl set effect.
inventory: Saradomin godsword or special attack weapon
notes: This method preserves the wiki's Melee (Single combat) equipment tab.

methods.label: Elder stalker and superior focus
methods.summary: Prioritise Elder custodian stalkers after 76 Slayer because only elders can spawn Ancient Custodian and they have better unique drops.
recommendedFor: Antler guard and alchemist's signet hunting
requiredOrKeyItems: Bigger and Badder for Ancient Custodian spawns
steps: At 76 Slayer, target Elder custodian stalkers instead of juvenile or mature variants where possible.
Keep the same combat method as your chosen area.
Kill Ancient Custodian superior spawns when they appear.
notes: The task page explicitly encourages reaching 76 Slayer for elders because only they can spawn the superior and they have better drops.
